title: Both VSX members rebooted in one window at HYD-POD-2 (synthetic)
symptom: A change ticket upgraded both VSX members in parallel. Every dual-homed host in the rack lost connectivity for 47 minutes, including the storage VLAN.
lesson: Upgrade VSX members in separate waves and confirm the peer is forwarding before starting the second member.

title: Single-homed host isolated during ToR maintenance (synthetic)
symptom: A host with one err-disabled uplink was isolated when its remaining ToR rebooted; HA did not restart VMs because the host stayed powered on.
lesson: Check LLDP for every host before ToR maintenance; evacuate single-homed hosts first.
